summary: Full backend + frontend testing of 5P (Five Posts) MVP. Rewrote backend test suite (previous file targeted obsolete CampusTalk schema). 18/18 backend tests pass. Frontend smoke covers gate, register email-gate (block + success), feed slot header/grid, state indicators, admin login, anonymous vs admin author labels, compose entry. All critical flows green.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout (auth playbook recommends 5-fail lockout). Acceptable for MVP.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; works in current preview but Safari/Firefox strict modes may reject. Pin to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL origin.

Champion 'admin direct line' synthetic conv only appended if no real msgs exist for that cid yet. The admin_line cid suffix '::admin_line' diverges from regular cid; ensure UI handles both; confirmed via code review.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, posts, messages, status) before further growth.
compute_status() runs a Mongo count on every status request; for scale add a small in-memory cache keyed by (date_key, user_id) with short TTL.
get_or_create_daily_state inserts unlock_at as ISO string but sometimes parses without tz fallback — defensively coerced via replace(tzinfo=utc); fine.
send_message admin_line triggers compute_status(other) which can be expensive; consider caching champion_id per request.
anon_handle uses 4-hex (16^4 = 65k) — collisions possible for >256 users in same conv list; acceptable for a 5-post/day app.
delete_post cascades comments but not messages; if a post-initiated DM thread should also drop, add cascade. (Likely intentional: DM persists separately.)
Frontend cookies depend on samesite=none + secure=true which require HTTPS; works on preview URL. Local dev http will break auth.
No rate limit on /api/auth/register — anyone could spam-create iastate emails (no email verification). Add captcha or magic-link verification before production.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@iastate.edu / admin123 (auto-seeded). Test users: registered dynamically as test_<hex>@iastate.edu / testpass123.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient users + posts; admin posts cleaned up by tests via admin DELETE. Some test_*@iastate.edu users will accumulate (no cleanup endpoint); harmless in dev DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Tests directly mutate db.daily_state.unlock_at (via motor) to deterministically exercise GOLDEN_HOUR_LOCKED and post-unlock paths. SERVER_FULL not exercised explicitly but covered via status assertions; to test, register 5 users + backdate unlock + each posts. Champion path not tested (requires yesterday data); admin_line conv list confirmed by code review only. data-testids verified: gate-login-btn, gate-start-btn, register-email-input, register-password-input, register-submit-btn, register-error, login-*, available-headline, slot-grid, slot-N-filled/empty, state-can-post/done/waiting/spectator, compose-btn, profile-logout, admin-flag.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features behave per spec.
